'''Hibbertopterus scouleri''' is an [[extinct]] [[aquatic]] arthropod from the [[wikipedia:Devonian|Devonian]] era, found in [[temperate]] freshwater or brackish [[lake]]s and [[river]]s.

Despite their size (as big as a dwarf), they are not butcherable or fishable, although they have the {{token|COOKABLE_LIVE|creature}} token.

Some dwarves [[Preferences|like]] hibbertopterus scouleri for their ''broad heads''.
